name: @pinpoint/tokens
comment: dependencies is intentionally absent. This package holds platform-neutral literals and pure functions over them — the single source of truth the styling spec requires. src/ is authoritative and hand-written; src/generated/ is derived from it by scripts/derive.ts and must never be edited, and CI fails on a diff. The direction is one way: nothing recovers a token by parsing the generated stylesheet. Adding a runtime dependency here means something other than a token value has been put in it.
